introHtml: Cotton poly work shirts combine the softness of cotton with the durability and wrinkle resistance of polyester, making them a practical choice for uniforms that need to look professional shift after shift. The blended fabric breathes better than pure polyester while holding up to frequent washing, which is why safety managers and HR directors often choose this material for warehouse teams, maintenance crews, and field service staff. Common decoration options include screen printing and embroidery, both of which adhere well to the smooth cotton-poly surface.
